skill.name: visioncraft
skill.description: Guides visual generation through Agnes AI for images, image transformations, videos, multi-image sequences, and keyframe animation.
skill.summary: Create and transform images or videos with documented Agnes AI workflows.
skill.author: BAI-32

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown, documentation, placeholder, or ignore-rule false positives. The skill genuinely directs PowerShell execution and environment-key access, and it instructs users to print the API key. Its required scripts and references are absent, preventing implementation review.

remediation.issue: The verification command prints the complete AGNES_API_KEY.
remediation.suggestion: Replace it with a presence-only check that reports whether the variable exists without returning its value.

remediation.issue: The package omits every PowerShell script and reference file required by its instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Include the referenced files, verify their integrity, and repeat the security audit before publication.

remediation.issue: Broad activation can start a third-party generation workflow without explicit confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation before sending prompts or image URLs to Agnes AI, especially when generation can incur charges.

content.user_title: Create Images and Videos with Agnes AI
content.value_statement: Visual generation requires careful prompts, parameters, and workflow selection. VisionCraft maps natural-language requests to documented Agnes AI image and video workflows.
actual_capabilities: Selects text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, multi-image, or keyframe workflows.
Suggests stronger prompts using subject, scene, style, lighting, composition, action, and camera details.
Maps aspect ratio, duration, frame rate, seed, and negative prompts to documented PowerShell parameters.
Explains required video frame-count rules and common Agnes AI errors.
Presents a generated media URL on a separate line when the external workflow succeeds.
limitations: The audited package does not include the PowerShell scripts or reference files named by its instructions.
Generation requires Windows, PowerShell 7 or later, an Agnes AI account, and a valid API key.
Prompts and source image URLs may be processed by Agnes AI under its external service terms.
Availability, pricing, output quality, and generation time depend on Agnes AI.

use_cases.title: Develop Visual Concepts
use_cases.description: Create image concepts from structured descriptions of subject, setting, style, lighting, and composition.

use_cases.title: Prepare Campaign Media
use_cases.description: Draft posters, product visuals, and short videos in formats suited to campaign channels.

use_cases.title: Animate Reference Frames
use_cases.description: Plan image-to-video, multi-image, and keyframe transitions with explicit motion and identity constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a square image of [subject] in [setting]. Use [style] and [lighting]. Return the media URL.

prompt_templates.title: Transform an Existing Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Transform [image URL] into [new style]. Change [elements], preserve [elements], and use [aspect ratio].

prompt_templates.title: Direct a Short Video
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration]-second [aspect ratio] video of [subject] [action] in [scene]. Use [camera movement], [lighting], and [frame rate].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Keyframe Transition
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a keyframe animation between [first image URL] and [second image URL]. Preserve [identity details] and describe a smooth [transition].

output_examples.input: Create a square poster of a floating city at sunrise with cinematic realism.
output_examples.output: Image generated. The response presents the Agnes AI media link on a separate line.

output_examples.input: Restyle this product image with soft studio lighting while preserving its shape and label.
output_examples.output: Image transformed. The response preserves the requested details and presents the result link separately.

output_examples.input: Animate two reference frames with a smooth camera move and consistent character identity.
output_examples.output: Video generated. The response reports the selected duration and dimensions, then presents the media link.

best_practices: Review the final prompt, external-service terms, and expected cost before generation.
For transformations, state what must change and what must remain unchanged.
Prefer aspect ratio and duration controls unless exact dimensions or frame counts are required.
anti_patterns: Do not print, paste, or return the Agnes AI API key.
Do not assume the omitted scripts are available or safe without inspection.
Do not send private source images to Agnes AI without user approval.

faq.question: What can VisionCraft create?
faq.answer: It documents workflows for images, image transformations, videos, multi-image sequences, and keyframe animation.

faq.question: Does it require an external account?
faq.answer: Yes. Generation requires an Agnes AI account and API key.

faq.question: Which environment does it support?
faq.answer: The documented commands target Windows with PowerShell 7 or later.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide an accessible image URL and describe both the requested changes and preserved elements.

faq.question: Can it animate multiple images?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented modes include multi-image video and keyframe transitions between reference frames.

faq.question: Is this package ready to generate media?
faq.answer: No. The audited package omits the PowerShell scripts and reference files required by its instructions.
